title: fix: align UI demo labels and tooltip guidance
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: The React UI demo now uses FieldStack for seven showcase inputs and textareas, connecting their visible labels to the controls. Standalone prompt inputs and the preview slider have accessible names. Inline help can open by touch, Enter, or Space; the Primitives tooltip example now demonstrates centered, hoverable content and Escape dismissal. The demo README adds guidance for labels, descriptions, tooltip triggers, stylesheet imports, and manual accessibility checks.
